2026 Aflac Holiday Duck marks the 25th year that the quacking collectible has helped children with cancer and blood disorders


COLUMBUS, Ga.


, Nov. 3, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Aflac, a leading provider of supplemental health insurance in the U.S., is celebrating a milestone anniversary with the release of the 2026 Aflac Holiday Duck, marking the 25th year of the beloved annual tradition that has become a holiday must-have for families across America while helping bring comfort, hope and support to children facing cancer and blood disorders across the United States.


Since its debut in 2001, the Aflac Holiday Duck program has generated nearly $4.7 million in donations through net proceeds, benefiting participating hospitals across the U.S. that treat pediatric oncology and hematology patients. What began as a seasonal collectible has become a cherished symbol of generosity, with each annual duck helping support Aflac's long-standing commitment to pediatric cancer and blood disorders patients and their families.


The 2026 Aflac Holiday Duck features a cozy winter-ready look, dressed in a vibrant green hooded, puffy vest trimmed with white faux fur. The keepsake also includes festive holiday details, including a red-and-white candy cane accent and commemorative 2026 ribbon. Give it a squeeze to hear the iconic Aflac quack.


"The Aflac Holiday Duck is an American tradition including families having collected at least one from each of the 25 years that it has been sold, with all of the net proceeds going toward childhood cancer and blood disorders-related causes," Aflac Chairman and CEO Dan Amos said. "The Aflac Duck has helped make Aflac a leader in our industry and a household name, but we are equally proud that it is such a big part of our philanthropic program — giving back to children and families going through difficult times."


Funds raised through Holiday Duck sales go to the Aflac Childhood Cancer Foundation Inc. and complement Aflac's broader commitment to childhood cancer and blood disorders, supporting pediatric health initiatives nationwide. This year, Aflac, its sales agents and employees marked[more than $200 million](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812540-1&h=705651458&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnewsroom.aflac.com%2F2026-09-09-Aflac-commemorates-National-Childhood-Cancer-and-Sickle-Cell-Disease-Awareness-Month&a=more+than+%24200+million) in donations to the Aflac Cancer and Blood Disorders Center of Children's Healthcare of Atlanta, since 1995.


"For 25 years, the Aflac Holiday Duck has helped turn holiday giving into meaningful support for children and families navigating some of life's most difficult challenges," said president of the Aflac Childhood Cancer Foundation, Kerry Hand. "This year, we not only are celebrating a beloved tradition but also the generosity of customers, employees and supporters who have helped make a lasting difference in communities across the country."


The 2026 Aflac Holiday Duck is available while supplies last in both 6-inch ($14) and 10-inch ($23) sizes at[www.aflacchildhoodcancer.org](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812540-1&h=1141824663&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aflacchildhoodcancer.org%2F&a=www.aflacchildhoodcancer.org) .


**Frequently** **Asked** **Questions**


**What is the 2026 Aflac Holiday Duck?** The 2026 Aflac Holiday Duck is the 25th-anniversary edition of Aflac's annual holiday collectible. The plush duck is dressed in a green hooded winter vest with white faux-fur trim and festive holiday accents.


**How much money has the Holiday Duck program raised?** Net proceeds from Aflac Holiday Duck sales have generated nearly **$4.7 million** to support hospitals and programs that treat children with cancer and blood disorders across the United States.


**Where can I purchase the 2026 Aflac Holiday Duck?** The 2026 Aflac Holiday Duck is available in 6-inch ($14) and 10-inch ($23) sizes while supplies last at[www.aflacchildhoodcancer.org](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812540-1&h=1141824663&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aflacchildhoodcancer.org%2F&a=www.aflacchildhoodcancer.org) .


**Has Aflac supported pediatric cancer programs beyond the Aflac Holiday Duck?** Yes. The Aflac Holiday Duck is one part of the company's more than 30 years and counting commitment to supporting children with cancer and blood disorders through funding, partnerships and advocacy efforts, including the award-winning My Special Aflac Duck® program. Introduced in 2018, nearly 50,000 My Special Aflac Duck comforting robotic companions have been given — free of charge— to children with cancer and blood disorders across the United States, Japan and Northern Ireland. For information, visit aflacchildhoodcancer.org.
